It combines world, galaxy, population, location, NPC, dialogue, faction, quest, and painterly-map tools with the Universal Covenant Engine.\\n\\n## Campaign scope\\n\\nThe simulator supports only the campaign eras the setting is intended to play:\\n\\n- Era 3 \u2014 Medieval\\n- Era 4 \u2014 Renaissance / Early Modern\\n- Era 5 \u2014 Industrial / Steam\\n- Era 6 \u2014 Electrified / Modern\\n- Era 7 \u2014 Digital / Atomic\\n- Era 8 \u2014 Planetary / Orbital\\n- Era 9 \u2014 Interplanetary\\n- Era 10 \u2014 Spacefaring / Interstellar\\n\\nPlanetary formation, geography, climate, orbital mechanics, and deep history remain available as world-building tools. Population, settlement, NPC, technology, reaction, and campaign-era generation never operate below Medieval. Imported older projects are normalized to this range.\\n\\n## Start the application\\n\\n1. Extract the archive.\\n2. Serve the `UniversalSimulator` folder with a static web server. For example, run `python -m http.server 8000` from the folder.\\n3. Open `http://localhost:8000/`.\\n\\nOpening `index.html` directly still exposes the built-in runtime rules index, but a web server is recommended so the nine full JSON rule files and ZIP/DOCX imports can load reliably.\\n\\n## Universal Covenant Engine integration\\n\\nThe canonical JSON files live in `json/universal_system/`:\\n\\n1. `universal_classes.json`\\n2. `universal_alignments.json`\\n3. `universal_pantheon.json`\\n4. `universal_races.json`\\n5. `universal_time_conversion.json`\\n6. `universal_how_to_play.json`\\n7. `universal_5e_spells.json`\\n8. `universal_ichor.json`\\n9. `universal_factions_and_quest_hooks.json`\\n\\nNPC generation can create unclassed civilians or classed characters using the 22-class roster and all 81 alignment profiles. Generated profiles include Covenant Engine level, HP, proficiency, Guard, Stress, Composure, Resolve, Ichor, deity/covenant fields, and stable references to the full rule data.\\n\\n## Compatibility\\n\\nOlder LifeSimulation v5 state and packages remain importable. The legacy JavaScript namespace and some folder names remain only to avoid breaking existing bridges, imports, saved projects, and asset paths. All user-facing product names, new schemas, new saves, and new exports use UniversalSimulator.\\n\\nThe app uses \u201cDM\u201d throughout new Universal-facing content.\\n\"}");
